text:
Nia H: FYI a hiring manager flagged that all interviewer invites for the SRE interviews show up an hour earlier in their calendars.
Omar T: which timezone?
Nia H: Candidates in PST, invites landed showing 08:00 instead of 09:00 local.
Kai S: Any clue from ATS export? I was working on the scorecard fields earlier.
Nia H: I pulled the CSV and noticed `interviewer_timezone` has mixed formats: some rows `America/Los_Angeles`, others `-0700`, and a few `PST`.
Omar T: We only normalize Olson tz names right now. Offsets like `-0700` were parsed as hours-only and we lost DST handling.
Riley M: So offset-only rows end up getting parsed as UTC-7 fixed, which is wrong for dates that cross DST boundaries.
ats-sync-bot: [09:32] ATS import warning: row 42: timezone "PST" ambiguous, defaulting to UTC-8
Kai S: Quick mitigation: prefer IANA tz if present, otherwise fallback to a mapping table for common abbreviations, and treat numeric offsets as temporary but log alerts.
Omar T: Can we do a targeted backfill for the cohort? Interviews start tomorrow and rescheduling will be painful.
Kai S: I'll push a small importer update to accept all three formats and add a flag `tz_source` so we can audit which rows came from offsets/abbr.
Nia H: timeline?
Kai S: 30 min to deploy and run targeted backfill for rows with non-IANA tz. I'll also run a dry-run to show changed invite times.
Omar T: I'll re-export the SRE interviewer file and tag it `sre-tz-fix.csv` for the backfill job.
Riley M: Also add a pre-import validation that flags non-IANA timezones in Slack so people correcting the CSV know what's wrong.
ats-sync-bot: [09:50] Backfill job tz-backfill-2115000000 completed: 9 invites updated, 2 flagged for manual calendar confirmation.
Nia H: Confirmed invites now show 09:00 in PST for the updated rows.
Omar T: I'll add the tz mapping table to Recruiting Ops runbook and open a small GH issue to track adding stricter exporter warnings to the ATS side.
Kai S: I'll log unit tests for tz parsing edge cases (abbrs, numeric offsets, DST transitions).
Riley M: Great catch, team. Saved a lot of rescheduling later :relieved:
